ai.s: Finance can approve or reject newly created client events in the Admin Panel, with reasons, notes and automatic emails to the linked TAMs.
ai.pr: Client events created in the Admin Panel had no in-platform Finance approval step, so approvals and rejections were not tracked or communicated to TAMs.
ai.wy: Part of the Onboarding Journey; Finance-role users control which events go live.
ai.oc: Waiting for approval, Active and Rejected tabs, a review side panel with checklist, rejection reasons and notes, a test-state indicator, editable rejected events and TAM emails.

summary: New Admin List Screen and Creation

ai.s: TAMs and organisers create and manage event admin users from a new Admin List screen, with permissions and an onboarding email for the first admin.
ai.pr: There was no streamlined way for TAMs and organisers to create organiser admin users with event access and permissions and start their onboarding.
ai.wy: Part of the Onboarding Journey and Admin Panel restructure; admin creation also reachable from the dashboard.
ai.oc: An Admin List page with User List, Admin Categories and MFA tabs, an Add Admin form with events access and Full Access or Read Only permissions, and a first-admin onboarding email prompt.

ai.s: Documented the elements an edit section can contain (title, subtitle, edit blocks, hints) so the team knows how edit sections should look.
ai.pr: The team did not know the full structure of edit sections, such as which titles, subtitles, fields and hints can appear and where.
ai.wy: Needed as a reference to build edit sections consistently.
ai.oc: A description of edit section elements, including maximum contents and hint placement, with an optional full tab view.

summary: Attendance: Organizer can compare unique Attendee Check-ins across Events in Total Check-In / Check-Out graph

ai.s: Organisers can compare unique attendee check-ins and check-outs across co-located events in the Total Check-In / Check-Out graph.
ai.pr: Organisers running several co-located events in one client environment had to switch between events to monitor attendance during the live phase.
ai.wy: Part of Attendance and Event Analytics 2026: live cross-event attendance monitoring.
ai.oc: An Events multi-select filter on the graph showing grouped bars of unique check-ins and check-outs per event, counting each attendee once per event per time bucket.

summary: Not able to scroll filters and banner to end until you scroll down whole marketplace(cards) down.

ai.s: Fixed marketplace scrolling so filters and the banner can be scrolled to the end without scrolling through all cards when infinite scroll is on.
ai.pr: With infinite scroll enabled, users could not scroll the marketplace filters and banner to the end until they had scrolled down the whole list of cards.
ai.wy: UX bug on the marketplace listing.
ai.oc: Filters and banner scroll independently of the card list on the marketplace with infinite scroll enabled.

ai.s: Addressed Sentry-reported issues for the Visitor team (ticket had no further detail).
ai.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title — no description was provided.
ai.wy: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed fixes for errors reported in Sentry; on hold.

summary: Redirection to mobile app post webview login (SSO login - Cosmoprof)

ai.s: After logging in through the Cosmoprof webview or SSO, mobile app users are redirected back to the app and land on the home page logged in.
ai.pr: The Cosmoprof webview login did not return users to the app afterwards, and the original SSO story could not be delivered in time.
ai.wy: Workaround for EP-49318 under time pressure, for the Cosmoprof login flow.
ai.oc: A backend-configured webview URL containing a redirect key, so after webview or SSO login the user returns to the app's home page in a logged-in state.

summary: [Exhibitor Settings] The Exhibitor is not present at this event

ai.s: Fixed exhibitors that appear in search but fail to open, showing "The Exhibitor is not present at this event" in the admin panel and a 404 on the front end.
ai.pr: Some exhibitors, such as one found by searching "Soap", were returned by the search API but opening them gave an error in the admin panel and a 404 on the profile.
ai.wy: Data consistency bug in exhibitor settings.
ai.oc: Exhibitors returned by search can be opened in both the admin panel and the front end without errors.

ai.s: Fixed the profile ticketing page layout after the Next14 upgrade so it matches the Next12 version.
ai.pr: The profile/ticketing page rendered differently under Next14 compared with Next12, as shown in comparison screenshots.
ai.wy: Part of fixing issues after the Next14 update.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed profile/ticketing page restored to its Next12 appearance; on hold.

summary: Avoid of using phpsession, use token instead

ai.s: Backend endpoints authenticate with the token instead of relying on the PHP session first.
ai.pr: Several backend endpoints, such as tickets and meetingProgram list, used the PHP session before the x-auth-token, which caused inconsistent behaviour.
ai.wy: Technical correctness: token-based authentication for the new frontend.
ai.oc: Endpoints prioritise the auth token over phpsession when identifying the user.

ai.s: Rebuilt search ranking on Qdrant with tiered name matching, typeahead and no dead ends, with IMEX as the first validation client.
ai.pr: Search was broken: coordinators outranked exact partner matches, substrings added noise, spacing and country variants failed and users hit blank pages.
ai.wy: IMEX requirements for search, validated first with IMEX.
ai.oc: A V1 data science scope: tiered deterministic ranking, exhibitors, people and sessions indexed, typeahead, Top Results, Quick Links, organiser settings and a sub-500ms latency target.

ai.s: Fixed uncaught errors on the root page of the Next14 frontend.
ai.pr: The Next14 build threw uncaught errors on the root page, as shown in a screenshot.
ai.wy: Part of fixing issues after the Next14 update.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed the root page loads without uncaught errors.

summary: Back/ Pls update behaviour of "Clear DB" btn

ai.s: The Clear database button now returns refreshed app data immediately instead of after a 10-minute cache delay.
ai.pr: Pressing Clear database sent a new timestamp to app/getexhibitions, but the cached endpoint returned updated data only after about 10 minutes.
ai.wy: Organisers and QA need changes to reach the app straight away.
ai.oc: The getexhibitions request bypasses the cache after Clear database, so updated data is returned immediately.

ai.s: Refactored the Next14 socket context, including assessing a socket connection without third-party services.
ai.pr: The socket context in the Next14 frontend needed refactoring, and relying on a third-party service for socket connections was being questioned.
ai.wy: Part of fixing issues after the Next14 update.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed refactored socket context and a review of a native socket connection.

ai.s: Attendees get a rebuilt search experience with grouped typeahead, a Top Results block, quick links and no dead-end pages, per IMEX requirements.
ai.pr: Search results were hard to navigate and could leave users on a blank page with no guidance.
ai.wy: IMEX requirement for search; application layer on top of the Qdrant ranking rebuild.
ai.oc: Grouped typeahead with Quick Link chips, a results page with Top Results, quick links and fixed organiser-ordered entity blocks with Show more, and no-dead-end states.
